activities.text: Closed the Ottawa sprint — backup retention finally fixed, only the optional test left
Ran the schedule audit, then corrected myself — nothing actually due today, flight home tonight
Picked the travel look — warm coat, cozy scarf, little suitcase for the flight back
Morning briefing done — Sunday family day in Ottawa, no classes, wheels up at six
Made Princess Rheia ep 1 for the gymnastics drive — giggles stolen, banana pants saved the day
Rheia demanded more — eps 2 through 5, absurdity on max, loudness balanced before publishing
Rebuilt the Drive-Time jobs the same way — balance first, then publish, no raw mixes
Pitched George his own Morning Show — Angie green-lit it, first brief posted
Parents popped in with pilaf and blinchiki, then drove him to the airport
Ottawa mode off — out the door to YOW, Thunder Bay rules resume
In the air at last — third gate change, never cancelled, Colten texted at 40 minutes out
Landed in Thunder Bay on time — Colten collected him, ligma relay delivered
Evening replay — rewriting this house as the day actually happened, water bottle for dinner
